newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai May car sales fall 15.4 pct yr/yr-Toyota.
newsitem.headline: Thai May car sales fall 15.4 pct yr/yr-Toyota.

text.p: Sales of passenger cars and commercial vehicles in Thailand were down 15.4 percent in May to 41,961 units from 49,595 a year earlier, Toyota Motors (Thailand) said on Monday.
A steep fall in sales of commercial vehicles led the overall market drop in May, the company said.
Sales of commercial vehicles in May declined 25.8 percent to 25,825 units from 34,789 in the same month last year, it said.
Cumulative vehicles sales in the first five months fell 12.5 percent to 211,682 units from 241,951 in the same period in the previous year, Toyota said in a statement.
Toyota cars topped Thai vehicle sales in May with a 30.9 percent market share on sales of 12,964 units, compared with 13,888 in the same month a year ago, the company said.
Isuzu Motors vehicles came second with 9,913 units sold in May, representing 23.6 percent share, against 9,780 in the same month last year.
Toyota passenger car sales in the month totalled 6,003 compared with 4,831 a year earlier. It was the top passenger car seller with 37.2 percent market share.
Honda Motor was second with 4,669 sold in the month, or 22.6 percent of the passenger car market, against 2,438 a year earlier, it said.
